build_synthesis_network: build a synthesis network that maps latent arrays to images using 1x1 convolutions with configurable layers
create_residual_wrapper: create a residual wrapper that adds input to the output of a Haiku module for residual connections
build_edge_padding: build edge padding for image or video tensors using replication padding along spatial dimensions
create_bias_initializer: create a custom bias initializer that sets bias values to a specified array or zeros
test_synthesis_call: test the Synthesis module by passing latent arrays and verifying clipped image output shapes
